2.2 PURCHASE PRICE
The purchase price for the Shares (the “Purchase Price”) is  FOUR-MILLION TWO-HUNDRED FIFTY-THOUSAND dollars (U.S.$4,250,000.00), plus or minus the Adjustment Amount. At the Closing, Buyer shall deliver as payment on account of the Purchase Price: (a) THREE-MILLION EIGHT-HUNDRED TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND dollars (U.S.$3,825,000) (the “Closing Payment”), which will be allocated among Sellers as set forth on Schedule 2.2, and which shall be paid by wire transfer to Sellers’ Representative pursuant to written wire transfer instructions delivered to Buyer by Sellers’ Representative at least three (3) Business Days prior to the Closing; (b) promissory notes executed by Buyer and payable to each Seller, in the principal amounts set forth on Schedule 2.2 (collectively, the “Promissory Notes”), in the form of Exhibit 2.2(b); and (c) FOUR-HUNDRED TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND dollars (U.S.$425,000) paid by wire transfer to the Escrow Agent pursuant to the Escrow Agreement (the “Escrow Funds”). The Adjustment Amount shall be paid by Sellers or Buyer, as the case may be, in accordance with Section 2.5.
